$xy\prime+y=x^2+3x+2$ 的通解为（ ） $\frac{x^2}{3}+\frac32x+2+C$ $\frac1x(\frac{x^3}{3}+\frac{x^2}{2}+2)+C$ $\frac1x(\frac{x^3}{3}+\frac{x^2}{2}+2x)+C$ $\frac1x(\frac{x^3}{3}+\frac{3x^2}{2}+2x+C)$ 将方程改写为 $y'+\frac{1}{x}y=x+3+\frac{2}{x}$，则

$$y=e^{-\int\frac{1}{x}\,dx}\left[\int\left(x+3+\frac{2}{x}\right)e^{\int\frac{1}{x}\,dx}\,dx+C\right]=\frac{1}{x}\left[\int\left(x+3+\frac{2}{x}\right)x\,dx+C\right]=\frac{1}{x}\left[\int(x^2+3x+2)\,dx+C\right]$$

$$=\frac{1}{x}\left(\frac{x^3}{3}+\frac{3x^2}{2}+2x+C\right)$$
